title: What masons do
d: Masons build with brick, block, and stone: walls, chimneys, fireplaces, patios, and foundations. It is physical, precise work — a wall out of plumb stays out of
description: Masons build with brick, block, and stone: walls, chimneys, fireplaces, patios, and foundations. It is physical, precise work — a wall out of plumb stays out of plumb forever. Apprenticeships run 3-4 years.

title: Essential tools
d: Brick trowel, pointing trowel, level, mason's line and blocks, story pole, brick hammer, 4-inch grinder with diamond blade, mortar mixer or hoe and box, and a s
description: Brick trowel, pointing trowel, level, mason's line and blocks, story pole, brick hammer, 4-inch grinder with diamond blade, mortar mixer or hoe and box, and a stiff brush. Pros add: wet saw and scaffolding.

title: Key skills
d: Spreading mortar with the trowel, buttering bricks, keeping courses level and plumb, cutting brick cleanly, striking joints neatly, and reading the bond pattern
description: Spreading mortar with the trowel, buttering bricks, keeping courses level and plumb, cutting brick cleanly, striking joints neatly, and reading the bond pattern. Speed comes from rhythm: the trowel hand never stops.

title: Safety essentials
d: Silica dust from cutting is a serious lung hazard — wet cut or respirators. Lift with legs; block is brutal. Scaffolding rules: guardrails and proper planking.
description: Silica dust from cutting is a serious lung hazard — wet cut or respirators. Lift with legs; block is brutal. Scaffolding rules: guardrails and proper planking. title: Pro tips
